note: Real OSM footprints and road alignments textured with cropped photographs of real Manila building facades. Photos are reused across facade batches and are not a full photogrammetry reconstruction; buildings without suitable photographs still require additional photo coverage.
facade_texture_source: real Manila building photographs from Real-Facade-Photos, cropped into facade texture atlases
facade_texture_method: four or more photographic building facade atlases sourced from real Manila buildings; facade regions cropped before projection; no procedurally drawn window grids
